name: We One Aviation
note: Original Hinglish prompts, lexicon, CTA and logo are kept; this profile adds the academy's own knowledge and the content mix.
niche: pilot training (DGCA ground classes, CPL pathway) and aviation explainers for India
tone: Hinglish (about 60-70 % English), friendly senior-pilot-mentor energy: clear, exact, encouraging, never hype. Teaches like a good instructor: one concept, made obvious.
business: We One Aviation is a pilot-training academy in Dwarka, New Delhi (since 2009). It teaches the DGCA CPL ground subjects in classroom batches in Dwarka and online batches for students outside Delhi, guides students on the full CPL pathway (computer number, medicals, exams, flying school, interviews) and arranges flight training through partner flying schools in India and abroad. It does not own aircraft or run a flying school. Career counselling is free. Training never guarantees a licence or a job.
services: DGCA ground classes for CPL: Air Navigation, Aviation Meteorology, Air Regulations, Technical General, Technical Specific
RTR (A) radiotelephony preparation (examined separately from the five papers)
CPL pathway guidance: DGCA computer number, Class 2 / Class 1 medicals, Pariksha exam booking, eGCA licence application
Flight training arranged with partner flying schools in India and abroad (USA, Canada, South Africa, Australia, Sri Lanka guides on the site)
PPL and ATPL guidance; airline interview preparation
Free career counselling; classroom batches in Dwarka and online batches
usp: Teaches the exact DGCA syllabus, with study plans built around exam readiness
Honest guidance: published official rules and fees, no guaranteed jobs or pass promises
One place for the whole route: ground classes, exam booking, flying-school choice in India or abroad, interviews
audience: Class 11-12 students (PCM and non-PCM) and parents deciding on a pilot career
CPL students preparing for the DGCA papers and RTR
Graduates and career-switchers asking if it is too late
Aviation fans and flyers (reach audience for trending reels)
rules: Never claim pass rates, placement or job guarantees, 'number 1', 'best', 'oldest', pilots-trained counts or airline tie-ups.
Never name faculty, batch sizes or class timings. Never quote course fees (only official DGCA fees with their source).
Never promise salary; if pay comes up, use an authoritative published source and say it varies by airline.
Academy facts allowed: since 2009, Dwarka classroom + online batches, the five DGCA papers and RTR (A), free career counselling, flight training through partner flying schools.
Every exam/licence rule must be checked against DGCA (CAR Section 7, Pariksha / eGCA documents) at writing time; rules change.
No crash blame, no live investigations, nothing that mocks airlines or people.

market_facts.fact: DGCA CPL written papers: Air Navigation, Aviation Meteorology, Air Regulations, Technical General, Technical Specific (Aircraft Rules 1937, Schedule II); RTR (A) is a separate exam.
Pass mark is 70 % in each written paper, no aggregate (CAR Section 7 Series B Part I, para 5.6).
A CPL/ATPL written pass stays valid 5 years, counted back from the licence application (CAR Section 7, para 6.7).
DGCA exam fee: Rs 2,500 per paper in a regular session, Rs 5,000 in an on-demand session; paid via Bharatkosh; no refund once submitted.
2026 regular DGCA exam sessions: 10-14 March, 16-20 June, 22-26 September, 15-19 December (tentative); 8 on-demand sessions.
A DGCA computer number is needed before booking any exam; it can be obtained via DigiLocker or manually; exams are booked on pariksha.dgca.gov.in.
CPL needs 200 flying hours; minimum ages: 16 student pilot, 17 PPL, 18 CPL.

lanes.core: Academy lane: teach ONE real thing from pilot training — a DGCA ground-subject concept (Air Navigation, Aviation Meteorology, Air Regulations, Technical General/Specific, RTR), an exact DGCA exam/licence rule or step (computer number, medicals, Pariksha sessions, pass marks, validity, eGCA), or a pilot-career decision (after 12th, non-PCM route, India vs abroad, cadet vs CPL, type rating). Check what aspirants need right now (upcoming DGCA session dates, results, rule changes, admission season) and verify every rule on DGCA's own pages. The viewer should finish thinking: these people really know how to teach this. Never random trivia.
lanes.trending: Trending lane: aviation topics people are talking about right now (India first: news of the last 7 days, travel season, rules changing on a date, viral questions, myths) with the highest chance to be sent and saved. Still right for an academy's audience of aspiring pilots and flyers.
